source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 1
2. Set Health-Monitor via cmd: dcgmi health -s mpi
3. Check Health-Monitor via cmd: dcgmi health -c
4. Run Health-Test L3 via cmd: dcgmi diag -v -r 3
5. Disable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Health-Monitor should show ""Healthy"".
2. The result of Health-Test L3 should be PASS without errors."

original_test_intent: Configure and verify DCGM health monitoring, run the complete Level-3 memory diagnostic on the approved GPU set, verify tool-reported Healthy/PASS evidence without memory/ECC/thermal safety violation, and restore final state.
original_method: Validate DCGM/GPU/MIG/workload/memory/thermal baseline, execute the exact persistence enable, health-watch setup/check and verbose run-level-3 sequence under one approved plan, monitor Safety Stop signals, then restore approved persistence/monitor state.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the fixed L3 plan, workload blackout, limits and restoration. Commands, telemetry, Safety Stop enforcement and evidence capture are machine-executable; no physical/manual core is inherent.
required_inputs: Approved DCGM/dcgmi, driver and GPU target set
GPU memory/ECC/MIG/workload baseline and L3 coverage for deployed version
Temperature/ECC/timeout Safety Stop thresholds and resource headroom
safety_requirements: Quiesce approved GPU/MIG clients and confirm memory/thermal headroom before L3.
One approval covers the unchanged plan; stop on deviation, partial setup, timeout, thermal/ECC/driver fault or device loss.
Preserve full diagnostic/telemetry output and do not hide original failure or continue past a Safety Stop.
Restore only the approved final state; no automatic rerun, GPU reset, workload termination, service restart or driver reload.
agent_execution_scope: Validate tools, stable targets, baseline/workload blackout, limits and recovery gates.
Execute all source monitor/persistence steps and the exact verbose L3 diagnostic while collecting memory/ECC/thermal telemetry.
Apply Safety Stop, restore approved final state and collect post-health evidence.
Report DCGM Tool Result and deviations, not testcase verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve tools, targets, blackout, limits, full plan and restoration.
Decide disposition after any Safety Stop or partial diagnostic state.
Review Tool Result/telemetry and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A level-3-only alias may reach the diagnostic but omits required health/persistence steps and safety evidence; it is not complete coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve `dcgmi diag -v -r 3` and all surrounding source steps; accept alternative syntax only with deployed-version coverage proof.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five steps, `mpi`, verbose L3, criteria, script URL and 2/15-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE L3 WORKFLOW RETAINED WITH MEMORY SAFETY ENVELOPE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a per-GPU/DCGM-ID transaction with workload blackout, memory/ECC/thermal baseline and live limits, full L3 report, final restoration and event correlation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: DCGM-supported NVIDIA GPUs with sufficient memory/thermal headroom.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCGM/dcgmi, driver, GPU firmware, MIG mode, nvidia-smi, OS/kernel, BMC and workload runtime.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA DCGM diagnostics/health documentation for the deployed release and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds resource/safety and stable-identity controls without reducing L3 coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: DCGM L3 can consume memory and expose faults; tool PASS remains separate from engineer acceptance.

project_override_considerations: A project may set timeout/thermal limits, targets and final state. It must report actual L3 coverage and cannot claim the 15-minute master method when duration or tests are reduced without an approved override.
expected_evidence: DCGM/driver versions, stable GPU/MIG/memory/workload baseline and approval
Full verbose L3 report, return code, runtime and concurrent memory/ECC/thermal evidence
Safety-stop record if any, final restoration and GPU/BMC/OS health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criteria consistently require monitor Healthy and L3 PASS; editorial quotation errors do not change intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The L3 workflow is clear and automatable after case-specific package, safety and scheduling inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores omitted monitor/persistence steps and adds memory/ECC/thermal/timeout safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all critical L3 gates while correcting V3.1 classification from approval-gated PARTIAL to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies one-plan approval, explicit Safety Stop, no retry and separate Tool Result/engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a long memory diagnostic from running on active clients or beyond safety limits and prevents a standalone command from masking incomplete setup/restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: The complete L3 plan and monitoring can be automated; risk and approval do not imply a manual core. Therefore FULLY AUTOMATABLE is correct with strict readiness and Safety Stop gates.
